name: Cameron Proctor Residence

nadir.desc: The property consists of a primary residence and smaller detached structures set within a large rural lot|A long dirt driveway provides access from the road and leads to the developed area|Scattered trees and brush surround the buildings, with open dry ground between vegetation clusters|The remainder of the parcel is undeveloped wooded and brush-covered terrain.

alpha.desc: The approach to the property shows a long dirt driveway winding through scattered trees and dry open ground|The primary residence and detached structures sit near the end of the drive|Dense vegetation covers much of the surrounding terrain|The buildings occupy a relatively small clearing within the larger wooded lot.

bravo.desc: The left side of the property is dominated by scattered trees, brush, and dry open ground|The residence and outbuildings are visible in the distance near the driveway|Vegetation density varies across the slope, with thicker tree cover in some sections and more open brush in others.

charlie.desc: The rear of the property shows the residence and detached structures set against a backdrop of scattered trees and dry terrain|The long dirt driveway is visible approaching the developed area|Vegetation surrounds the buildings on multiple sides, with open ground immediately around the structures.

delta.desc: The right side of the property shows the dirt driveway leading to the primary residence and smaller detached structures|Scattered trees and brush cover the surrounding slopes|The developed area occupies a clearing within the larger rural lot|Open dry ground is present between vegetation clusters.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a long dirt driveway that winds from Crowfoot Rd to the residence and detached structures. The developed area is compact relative to the overall lot. Scattered trees and brush surround the buildings and may limit visibility from the road. The property is isolated in a rural setting with no neighboring structures visible in the immediate vicinity. Open ground around the buildings provides some space for movement once on site.
clarifications: Is the dirt driveway passable for standard emergency vehicles in all seasons? Are there any gates controlling access from Crowfoot Rd? Which structure is the primary residence versus outbuildings? Is vehicle access available around all sides of the main house, or does vegetation limit movement? Are there additional access points or trails not visible from the available imagery?
